args.stdin: WITH store AS (SELECT store_id, record_path FROM stores WHERE city='Graz' AND store_name LIKE '%PowerTool%' AND store_name LIKE '%north%' LIMIT 1), product1 AS (SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_variant_properties pvp ON pv.product_sku = pvp.product_sku WHERE pv.brand='Bosch' AND pv.series='Professional' AND pv.model='GSR 12V' AND pvp.property_key='Battery Voltage' AND pvp.property_value_text='12V' LIMIT 1), product2 AS (SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_variant_properties pvp ON pv.product_sku = pvp.product_sku WHERE pv.brand='Bosch' AND pv.series='Professional' AND pv.model='GWS 7-115' AND pvp.property_key='Disc Diameter' AND pvp.property_value_text='115mm' LIMIT 1), product3 AS (SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_variant_properties pvp ON pv.product_sku = pvp.product_sku WHERE pv.brand='Bosch' AND pv.series='Professional' AND pv.model='GBH 2-26' AND pvp.property_key='Impact Energy' AND pvp.property_value_text='2.6 J' LIMIT 1), product4 AS (SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_variant_properties pvp ON pv.product_sku = pvp.product_sku WHERE pv.brand='Makita' AND pv.series='XPT' AND pv.model='DHR242' AND pvp.property_key='Battery Voltage' AND pvp.property_value_text='18V' LIMIT 1), product5 AS (SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_variant_properties pvp ON pv.product_sku = pvp.product_sku WHERE pv.brand='Makita' AND pv.series='XPT' AND pv.model='DHP484' AND pvp.property_key='Battery Voltage' AND pvp.property_value_text='18V' LIMIT 1), product6 AS (SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_variant_properties pvp ON pv.product_sku = pvp.product_sku WHERE pv.brand='DeWalt' AND pv.series='XRP' AND pv.model='DCD791' AND pvp.property_key='Battery Voltage' AND pvp.property_value_text='20V' LIMIT 1), inventory AS (SELECT si.product_sku, si.available_today_quantity FROM store_inventory si JOIN store s ON si.store_id = s.store_id), counted AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM (SELECT product_sku FROM product1 UNION ALL SELECT product_sku FROM product2 UNION ALL SELECT product_sku FROM product3 UNION ALL SELECT product_sku FROM product4 UNION ALL SELECT product_sku FROM product5 UNION ALL SELECT product_sku FROM product6) all_products JOIN inventory i ON all_products.product_sku = i.product_sku WHERE i.available_today_quantity >= 4) SELECT s.record_path AS store_path, p1.record_path AS p1_path, p2.record_path AS p2_path, p3.record_path AS p3_path, p4.record_path AS p4_path, p5.record_path AS p5_path, p6.record_path AS p6_path, counted.cnt FROM store s, product1 p1, product2 p2, product3 p3, product4 p4, product5 p5, product6 p6, counted;
